show.description: Darshan, a humble repairman with a secret billionaire identity, unexpectedly helps a female CEO survive a corporate crisis.To repay him, she pretends to be his son’s stepmother—setting off a chain of misunderstandings and emotional conflict.When Darshan reveals his true power at his son’s banquet, disbelief turns to shock as the truth finally comes to light.
